venues.name: West Philly Porchfest
venues.notes: Neighbourhood: West Philly. Hundreds of porch shows, rock/punk/folk/indie heavy. Left out: 263 solo acts, 111 DJ sets, 31 kids'/school/youth/community ensembles (incl. community choirs, pipe and samba bands), 41 non-band listings (poetry, comedy, dance, drag, open mics/jams, karaoke, vendors), and 2 acts on 2 unapproved 2026 host entries the site itself hides.

notes: Source: the festival's public Firestore collection fests/{year}/hosts, read with the web key embedded in the site's own JS (the same request the schedule page makes). Times are each act's listed set time (site lists 12-hour times without AM/PM; festival runs noon-6 PM, so PM assumed, 10/11 as AM); when no set time was given the porch start time is used. Solo vs band was judged by hand from each act's own blurb; acts named after one person with no band/duo evidence were treated as solo, and group-sounding names with no blurb were kept as bands, so some solo projects may remain. Spelling variants of the same act were merged and second sets on the same day collapsed to one row. band_info description is the act's own one-line tagline from the listing; genre from the listing's genre tags (2026) or tagline. Host names and e-mails in the data were not recorded. Porch street addresses and house names were removed before publishing (private homes).
